programs.name: Master of Business Administration, International Business Management, part-time studies
programs.description: The Master's Degree Programme in Business Administration aims to strengthen students' professional competence for demanding development, management and expert positions. Organized as blended studies (lectures, online studies, project-based tasks), all courses in English.
programs.sourceQuote: # Master of Business Administration, International Business Management, part-time studies

requirements.sourceQuote: You can apply for a master’s degree programme if you have completed a suitable bachelor’s degree. In some cases, an equivalent degree obtained in other post-secondary level education also gives you eligibility to apply.
Additionally, a minimum of two years of work experience is required.
